acceptanceCriteria: A production command path calls the source rules on selected test files and reports ISOLATED-IN-SERIAL and MEMOIZED-BLOCK-EXPECTATION findings, covered by a command-level test
An invalid MEMOIZED-BLOCK-EXPECTATION finding refuses the example as proof through that command, covered by an end-to-end test
body: PR #1125 (V1-1783/V1-1784, TSA-V0-045..052) adds testsource.ValidityFindings and testvalidity ApplySourceFindings plus witness wiring tests, but no production caller invokes them: no CLI, preflight, receipt or obligations-witness output reports the findings. Expected: the test-validity surface used by callers (obligations witness / preflight / test-validity verdict output) runs the source rules on the selected test files and reports findings, and a MEMOIZED-BLOCK-EXPECTATION finding refuses the example as proof end to end. Actual: library-only.
title: Wire ISOLATED-IN-SERIAL and MEMOIZED-BLOCK-EXPECTATION findings to a user surface (residual of PR #1125)
